questions.question: How is King Jotham described?
options: He became mighty because he ordered his ways before the LORD
He was lazy and left the whole of the kingdom to fall to ruin
He was wicked and led all of Judah into terrible sin
He was defeated and lost a great deal of his land
questions.answer: He became mighty because he ordered his ways before the LORD
